# T-0131: Feature screenshots and user documentation

## Spec (written by Claude, do not edit)

### Why
Julio wants screenshots of the features we have and real documentation (asked 2026-09-30). The README and `docs/FEATURES.md` list features but show nothing, and there is no guide for a person using the app. Do this after the M5 web features settle (topics, prefs, search, pins), so the pictures do not go stale at once.

### What to build
1. **Screenshots** of the web app in mock mode (`?mock=1`, dev build) at a fixed size (1440x900, dark theme) plus a phone-size set (390x844): sign-in, chat list with topics, a topic with the task strip, a group with an AI, an approval card, message search, pinned banner, chat preferences (mute/archive/pin), the new-topic dialog. Saved as PNG under `docs/screenshots/` with stable names (`topics-desktop.png`). A script `scripts/screenshots.ts` regenerates them all so they can be refreshed; it drives a headless browser against the local mock build only, never a real server or real account.
2. **User guide** `docs/USER_GUIDE.md`: getting started, chats and groups, topics, AIs (create, keys, caps, approvals, kill switch), search, pins, mute/archive/pin, machines. Short sections, each with its screenshot. English, plain words, no promise for features that are not merged (mark them "coming").
3. **README**: a "See it" section with 3 to 4 of the best screenshots and a link to the guide. Keep it small.
4. Link the guide from `docs/FEATURES.md`.

### Dependencies
A headless browser is needed. Use Playwright (`@playwright/test` or `playwright`) as a **devDependency of the root or of `apps/web` only**; this task explicitly allows that one dependency. Do not commit browser binaries. If it cannot run on this machine, say so in the Report under "Blocked" instead of choosing another tool.

### Read first
`AGENTS.md`, `docs/FEATURES.md`, `README.md`, `apps/web/src/mock/` (what mock mode can show), `docs/LIVE_CHECKS_2026-09-29.md`.

### Allowed files
`docs/**` (except `PROJECT_PLAN.md`), `README.md`, `scripts/**`, the root or `apps/web` `package.json` and lockfile for the Playwright devDependency only, and `work/T-0131-screenshots-user-docs.md`.

### Checks
```bash
pnpm install
pnpm format:check
pnpm lint
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
```
Run the screenshot script once; PNGs must be under 400 KB each (optimize if needed). No real names, emails or keys may appear in any image (mock data only); look at every PNG before committing.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `docs/screenshots/` has the listed shots, desktop and phone, generated by the script.
- [ ] `docs/USER_GUIDE.md` covers every merged feature above and marks unmerged ones "coming".
- [ ] README "See it" section and FEATURES link added.
- [ ] Script never talks to a real server; only the machine's spare port (not 3000, 5173, 8081, 3188).

### Out of scope
Product code changes, mobile screenshots (simulators belong to Julio), a docs website.
